title: The Latest on the President’s Health

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《Dealbook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访几位商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经修饰的对话。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, it was a weekend of conflicting information about the president's health.
sentences.zh: 今天，关于总统健康状况的信息在周末出现了相互矛盾的情况。

sentences.en: I spoke again with my colleagues, White House Correspondents Peter Baker and
sentences.zh: 我再次与我的同事、白宫记者彼得·贝克和

sentences.en: Maggie Haberman.
sentences.zh: 玛吉·哈伯曼进行了交谈。

sentences.en: It's Monday, October 5th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月5日，星期一。

sentences.en: Maggie and Peter, the last time that we spoke to you late on Friday afternoon, the president
sentences.zh: 玛吉和彼得，上次我们在周五下午晚些时候与你们通话时，总统

sentences.en: was just about to board a helicopter for Walter Reed Medical Center, where he has spent the weekend.
sentences.zh: 正准备登上直升机前往沃尔特·里德医疗中心，他在那里度过了整个周末。

sentences.en: So let's talk about everything that has happened in the time since we last spoke.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们来谈谈自上次通话以来发生的一切。

sentences.en: To start with, tell us about the decision to send the president to Walter Reed.
sentences.zh: 首先，请告诉我们关于送总统去沃尔特·里德医疗中心的决定。

sentences.en: What did the White House say at that point about why the president was going to Walter Reed?
sentences.zh: 当时白宫对于总统为何要去沃尔特·里德医疗中心是怎么说的？

sentences.en: So, Michael, on Friday, when the president went to Walter Reed, the statement said from the press secretary, Kelly McEnany, that the president was going out of an abundance of
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，周五总统前往沃尔特·里德时，新闻秘书凯莉·麦肯纳尼发表声明称，总统此举是出于

sentences.en: caution.
sentences.zh: 谨慎考虑。

sentences.en: It was literally this was a precautionary measure and that they expected he would be there for a few days, quote unquote.
sentences.zh: 字面上说，这是一种预防措施，他们预计他会在那里待“几天”。

sentences.en: And what they were saying was that the president had mild symptoms, cold like symptoms, low grade fever, cough, sniffles, some chills.
sentences.zh: 他们当时说的是总统有轻微症状，类似感冒的症状、低烧、咳嗽、流鼻涕和一些寒战。

sentences.en: None of this was said officially.
sentences.zh: 这些都没有得到官方证实。

sentences.en: That was just what we were learning from our reporting.
sentences.zh: 那只是我们从报道中了解到的情况。

sentences.en: But our information was that it was a mild case.
sentences.zh: 但我们得到的消息是，这只是轻症。

sentences.en: And do we hear anything from the president directly?
sentences.zh: 我们有直接从总统那里听到什么吗？

sentences.en: Well, we see him walk from the White House to Marine One.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们看到他从白宫步行走向“海军陆战队一号”。

sentences.en: It's the first time we see him since he's had the positive teSt. The first time he's been in public in any view.
sentences.zh: 这是他检测呈阳性后我们第一次见到他。也是他第一次在公众视野中露面。

sentences.en: And he's wearing a suit and he's walking in his own, but you can tell he's sick.
sentences.zh: 他穿着西装，自己走着，但你能看出他病了。

sentences.en: He's listless.
sentences.zh: 他显得无精打采。

sentences.en: He looks like he is pale.
sentences.zh: 他看起来脸色苍白。

sentences.en: He doesn't have the normal energy.
sentences.zh: 他没有平时的那种活力。

sentences.en: He flashes a thumbs up, but it's kind of perfunctory to the reporters doesn't stop and talk, which he often almost always does.
sentences.zh: 他向记者竖起了大拇指，但那更像是一种敷衍，他没有停下来交谈，而他平时几乎总是会这样做。

sentences.en: And within minutes of that, I want to thank everybody for the tremendous support.
sentences.zh: 就在那几分钟内，他说：“我想感谢大家给予的巨大支持。”

sentences.en: They post a video on his Twitter account of him addressing the nation in effect just before walking out.
sentences.zh: 他们在他的推特账号上发布了一段视频，他在走出白宫前向全国发表了讲话。

sentences.en: I think I'm doing very well, but we're going to make sure that things work out.
sentences.zh: “我想我做得很好，但我们要确保一切顺利。”

sentences.en: And it's 18 seconds and doesn't say very much other than, you know, I'm here and I'm going to be okay.
sentences.zh: 这段视频只有18秒，除了说“我在这里，我会没事的”之外，没有说太多内容。

sentences.en: But it's meant to reassure the nation.
sentences.zh: 但这旨在安抚全国民众。

sentences.en: I think the problem for them is, of course, he didn't look like he was doing well, but he was ambulatory.
sentences.zh: 我认为对他们来说问题在于，他看起来确实不太好，但他还能走动。

sentences.en: He was awake.
sentences.zh: 他清醒着。

sentences.en: He was lucid.
sentences.zh: 他神志清楚。

sentences.en: And he obviously was meant to say, I'm in charge.
sentences.zh: 他显然是想表达：我还在掌控之中。

sentences.en: And, you know, not just speaking to the country, but to our adversaries and allies around the world.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这不仅是对全国人民说，也是对世界各地的对手和盟友说的。

sentences.en: So thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 所以非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: I will never forget it.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So what happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So the president spent the night on Friday and on Saturday late morning.
sentences.zh: 总统周五晚上在那里过夜，到了周六上午晚些时候。

sentences.en: Morning, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。

sentences.en: Thank you for coming.
sentences.zh: 感谢你们的到来。

sentences.en: Behind me are some of the members of the president's medical team whom I'd like to introduce.
sentences.zh: 站在我身后的是总统医疗团队的一些成员，我想向大家介绍一下。

sentences.en: A group of doctors treating the president came out of Walter Reed to address the pool reporters who were sent to Bethesda to hear what they had to say.
sentences.zh: 一组治疗总统的医生走出沃尔特·里德医疗中心，向被派往贝塞斯达采访的随行记者发表讲话。

sentences.en: Dr. Jason Blaylock, infectious disease.
sentences.zh: 传染病专家杰森·布莱洛克医生。

sentences.en: Dr. Wes Campbell, infectious disease.
sentences.zh: 传染病专家韦斯·坎贝尔医生。

sentences.en: Dr. John Hodgson, anesthesia.
sentences.zh: 麻醉科医生约翰·霍奇森医生。

sentences.en: And it was led by Dr. Conley, who is Trump's main doctor.
sentences.zh: 带头的是特朗普的主治医生康利医生。

sentences.en: And Maggie, it felt like that scene, which I watched, was a very deliberate show of medical force.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，我当时观看那个场景时，感觉那是一次非常刻意的医疗力量展示。

sentences.en: I think that's right, Michael.
sentences.zh: 我想你是对的，迈克尔。

sentences.en: I think it was meant to convey the significance and the breadth of the team treating the president.
sentences.zh: 我认为这旨在传达治疗总统的团队的重要性和规模。

sentences.en: And to be clear, there are a number of top doctors who are working on the president's team.
sentences.zh: 需要明确的是，总统团队中有多位顶尖医生。

sentences.en: They brought in specialists from Johns Hopkins, for instance.
sentences.zh: 例如，他们从约翰·霍普金斯大学请来了专家。

sentences.en: So they wanted to, I think, convey the sense that he is getting significant care, important care, and care that people can truSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我想他们是想传达一种感觉：他正在接受重要的、高质量的护理，这种护理是值得信赖的。

sentences.en: So, Peter, tell us about what happens during this news conference.
sentences.zh: 那么，彼得，请告诉我们这次新闻发布会上发生了什么。

sentences.en: This morning, I'd like to start by first sharing that the president is doing very well.
sentences.zh: “今天早上，我想首先分享的是，总统目前状况非常好。”

sentences.en: Well, Dr. Conley tells the world, basically, that the president is doing great.
sentences.zh: 嗯，康利医生基本上告诉全世界，总统状况极佳。

sentences.en: It should be clear that he's got plenty of work to get done from the chief of staff, and he's doing it.
sentences.zh: “应该明确的是，他还有很多工作要从幕僚长那里完成，他正在处理这些工作。”

sentences.en: He says that he's up and around, he's in good spirits, he's working.
sentences.zh: 他说总统已经起床走动，精神状态良好，正在工作。

sentences.en: And the president this morning is not on oxygen.
sentences.zh: “而且总统今天早上没有使用氧气。”

sentences.en: The other doctors even say that...
sentences.zh: 其他医生甚至说……

sentences.en: In fact, as we were completing our multidisciplinary rounds this morning,
sentences.zh: “事实上，当我们今天早上完成多学科查房时，”

sentences.en: the quote he left us with was, I feel like I could walk out of here today.
sentences.zh: “他留给我们的原话是：‘我觉得我今天就能走出这里。’”

sentences.en: The president told them he felt so good that he didn't have to stay if it was just up to him.
sentences.zh: 总统告诉他们他感觉很好，如果由他自己决定，他就不必留在这里了。

sentences.en: Thursday, he had a mild cough and some nasal congestion and fatigue, all of which are now resolving and improving.
sentences.zh: “周四，他有轻微咳嗽、鼻塞和疲劳，所有这些症状现在都在消退和好转。”

sentences.en: And they give a few details, but not many, about the infection and the course since the positive teSt.
sentences.zh: 他们提供了一些细节，但关于感染情况和检测呈阳性后的治疗过程，细节并不多。

sentences.en: The problem is, it's all very confusing, and it's conflicting with what the White House had told us before.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，这一切非常令人困惑，而且与白宫之前告诉我们的情况相矛盾。

sentences.en: Just 72 hours into the diagnosis now, the first week of COVID, and in particular, day 7 to 10 are the most critical in determining the likely course of this illness.
sentences.zh: “距离确诊仅72小时，新冠肺炎的第一周，特别是第7到第10天，是决定这种疾病可能病程的最关键时期。”

sentences.en: They refer to, for instance, the diagnosis being 72 hours earlier.
sentences.zh: 例如，他们提到确诊是在72小时前。

sentences.en: Well, that would place it a day earlier than we had thought it would be.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那比我们之前认为的时间要早一天。

sentences.en: About 48 hours ago, the president received a special antibody therapy directed against the coronavirus, and we're working very closely with the company to monitor him.
sentences.zh: “大约48小时前，总统接受了一种针对冠状病毒的特殊抗体疗法，我们正在与该公司密切合作以监测他的情况。”

sentences.en: They also referred to the president taking this experimental antibody cocktail 48 hours earlier, even though they had told us before it was only about 24 hours before.
sentences.zh: 他们还提到总统在48小时前使用了这种实验性抗体鸡尾酒疗法，尽管他们之前告诉我们这只是在24小时前。

sentences.en: So immediately, there are questions raised as to what is going on here.
sentences.zh: 所以，这里立刻引发了关于到底发生了什么的疑问。

sentences.en: Are they admitting that this has been going on longer than they had told us before?
sentences.zh: 他们是在承认这种情况比之前告诉我们的时间更长吗？

sentences.en: Did they just get it wrong?
sentences.zh: 还是他们只是搞错了？

sentences.en: Doctor, what was the date of the president's last negative test?
sentences.zh: 医生，总统上次检测呈阴性的日期是什么时候？

sentences.en: And then the questions start.
sentences.zh: 然后问题就开始了。

sentences.en: I'm not going to get into all the testing going back, but he and all the staff routinely are tested.
sentences.zh: “我不会去深究所有的检测记录，但他和所有工作人员都会定期接受检测。”

sentences.en: And he has not received any supplemental oxygen?
sentences.zh: “他没有接受过任何补充氧气吗？”

sentences.en: He's not on oxygen right now, that's right.
sentences.zh: “他现在没有吸氧，没错。”

sentences.en: And there's a lot of questions about whether the president had been on supplemental oxygen.
sentences.zh: 关于总统是否曾使用过补充氧气，有很多疑问。

sentences.en: He's not received any at all?
sentences.zh: “他一点都没接受过吗？”

sentences.en: He's not needed any this morning, today at all.
sentences.zh: “他今天早上，今天一整天都不需要。”

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: “没错。”

sentences.en: And that's where it really goes off the rails, because Dr. Connelly's just sort of dancing all around it.
sentences.zh: 事情就是从这里开始失控的，因为康利医生一直在回避问题。

sentences.en: If we just put you down on one thing, has he ever been on supplemental oxygen?
sentences.zh: “如果我们只问你一件事，他曾经使用过补充氧气吗？”

sentences.en: He, right now, he is not on oxygen.
sentences.zh: “他，现在，他没有吸氧。”

sentences.en: I understand.
sentences.zh: “我明白。”

sentences.en: I know you keep saying right now, but should we read into the fact that he had been previously?
sentences.zh: “我知道你一直说‘现在’，但我们是否应该解读为他之前确实用过？”

sentences.en: Yesterday and today, he was not on oxygen.
sentences.zh: “昨天和今天，他都没有吸氧。”

sentences.en: Saying things like, he's not on oxygen now.
sentences.zh: 说着“他现在没吸氧”之类的话。

sentences.en: Well, okay, that means he was on before, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，好吧，那意味着他之前用过，对吧？

sentences.en: So he has not been on it during this, his COVID treatment.
sentences.zh: “所以他在这次新冠治疗期间没有使用过。”

sentences.en: He's not on oxygen right now.
sentences.zh: “他现在没有吸氧。”

sentences.en: Well, he wouldn't say that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他不会那样说的。

sentences.en: And the sort of, you know, games playing and word parsing only simply made the situation even more confusing.
sentences.zh: 这种玩文字游戏和拆解词汇的做法，只会让情况变得更加混乱。

sentences.en: Thursday, no oxygen.
sentences.zh: “周四，没有吸氧。”

sentences.en: None at this moment.
sentences.zh: “此时此刻没有。”

sentences.en: Yeah, and yesterday with the team, while we were all here, he was not on oxygen.
sentences.zh: 是的，昨天和团队在一起时，当我们都在这里的时候，他没有吸氧。

sentences.en: Press, thank you.
sentences.zh: “媒体朋友们，谢谢。”

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: “非常感谢。”

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: “谢谢。”

sentences.en: Okay, so what happens after this press conference?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么这次新闻发布会之后发生了什么？

sentences.en: Watching this, of course, is Mark Meadows, the White House Chief of Staff.
sentences.zh: 当然，白宫幕僚长马克·梅多斯也在观看这场发布会。

sentences.en: And I think even he found it a little too much because within a couple minutes,
sentences.zh: 我想连他都觉得这有点过头了，因为几分钟之内，

sentences.en: he walks over to the pool of reporters who were there to represent all of the press corps and asked to speak to them off the record.
sentences.zh: 他走到代表所有媒体的记者群中，要求与他们进行非正式交谈。

sentences.en: And eventually gives them an assessment that sounds quite different than what Dr. Connolly had just said on camera.
sentences.zh: 最终给出的评估听起来与康利医生刚才在镜头前所说的截然不同。

sentences.en: How different?
sentences.zh: 有多不同？

sentences.en: Well, he tells reporters there that the president's vital signs were very concerning over the previous 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他告诉那里的记者，总统的生命体征在过去24小时内非常令人担忧。

sentences.en: That, in fact, he wasn't out of the woods and that the next 48 hours were going to be critical to determine the course of his recovery.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他还没有脱离危险，接下来的48小时对于确定他的康复进程至关重要。

sentences.en: It sounded much more sober, much more, you know, measured, certainly, than what Dr. Connolly had just said.
sentences.zh: 这听起来比康利医生刚才所说的要清醒得多，也谨慎得多。

sentences.en: I mean, clearly, you know, what he was doing was trying to pull back a little bit from the perhaps over-the-top optimism that was said on camera.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，很明显，他是在试图稍微收回镜头前那种可能过于乐观的言论。

sentences.en: Now, the problem for Mark Meadows is he didn't want to be identified, so he asked the reporters to call him a source who's familiar with the president's situation.
sentences.zh: 现在，马克·梅多斯的问题在于他不想被公开身份，所以他要求记者称他为“熟悉总统情况的消息人士”。

sentences.en: But what he didn't seem to realize was there was a live camera that had been recording everything.
sentences.zh: 但他似乎没意识到，现场有一台直播摄像机记录了一切。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: You could hear on the video that ends up being posted online, Meadows coming over to the reporter saying, hey, can we talk off the record?
sentences.zh: 在最终发布到网上的视频中，你可以听到梅多斯走到记者身边说：“嘿，我们能私下聊聊吗？”

sentences.en: If we can go off the record with some of y'all and get away from the camera.
sentences.zh: “如果我们能和你们中的一些人私下聊聊，远离摄像机。”

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: “当然。”

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: “好的。”

sentences.en: And why do you think Meadows would want to be unnamed?
sentences.zh: 你认为梅多斯为什么想保持匿名？

sentences.en: It felt like kind of an unexpected rollover.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是一种意想不到的“翻车”。

sentences.en: So you would expect that the White House would be the ones trying to put a more positive spin on it than the doctors.
sentences.zh: 你本以为白宫会是试图比医生给出更积极评价的一方。

sentences.en: So why would they want to be doing the opposite and doing it off the record?
sentences.zh: 那么他们为什么要反其道而行之，还要私下进行呢？

sentences.en: Well, or at least doing it on background, Michael,
sentences.zh: 嗯，或者至少是以背景信息的形式进行，迈克尔，

sentences.en: because the White House staff is well aware and Mark Meadows is well aware that the president does not want information about his health out there.
sentences.zh: 因为白宫工作人员很清楚，马克·梅多斯也很清楚，总统不希望有关他健康的信息流传出去。

sentences.en: And Mark Meadows was balancing the equities of what he thought the public should understand about the reality of the president's situation versus the president getting unhappy with that information being out there.
sentences.zh: 马克·梅多斯在权衡他认为公众应该了解的总统真实情况，与总统因这些信息泄露而感到不满之间，进行了平衡。

sentences.en: So he split the baby by going on background.
sentences.zh: 所以他通过提供背景信息的方式折中了。

sentences.en: So the chief of staff was willing to tell the public what he thought they needed to know, but not in such a way that he would then get a phone call from the president saying,
sentences.zh: 所以幕僚长愿意告诉公众他认为他们需要知道的事情，但又不想因此接到总统的电话质问：

sentences.en: what the heck did you just do?
sentences.zh: “你刚才到底干了什么？”

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But as it happens, that's what happened anyway.
sentences.zh: 但碰巧的是，事情还是发生了。

sentences.en: Meaning the president learned exactly what Mark Meadows had done.
sentences.zh: 意思是总统准确地知道了马克·梅多斯所做的事情。

sentences.en: And was not very happy about it.
sentences.zh: 而且对此非常不高兴。

sentences.en: So what happens?
sentences.zh: 那么发生了什么？

sentences.en: So the president learned of what happened, communicated that he was displeased, to put it mildly.
sentences.zh: 总统得知了发生的事情，并表达了他的不满，说得委婉一点。

sentences.en: And in short order, Mark Meadows was giving a rosier assessment of the president's condition to Reuters.
sentences.zh: 很快，马克·梅多斯就向路透社给出了关于总统状况更乐观的评估。

sentences.en: And Michael, this was an afternoon of backpedaling.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，这是一个不断“打脸”的下午。

sentences.en: You had Dr. Conley issue an additional memo short time after the briefing saying that he had misspoken on specific issues,
sentences.zh: 你在简报会后不久让康利医生发了一份补充备忘录，称他在某些具体问题上说错了话，

sentences.en: particularly about the timeline of when the president was first diagnosed and how far into his condition and the treatment of the virus that he actually was.
sentences.zh: 特别是关于总统首次确诊的时间，以及他当时感染病毒的严重程度和治疗进展。

sentences.en: Meaning the 72 hours versus 36 hours reference.
sentences.zh: 也就是指72小时和36小时的说法。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: At one point, Dr. Conley said, we're 72 hours into this diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 康利医生曾一度表示，我们确诊已经72小时了。

sentences.en: And that would have put it at Wednesday before the president took a couple of trips, one to Minnesota and one to New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 那意味着在总统周三前往明尼苏达州和新泽西州进行两次访问之前，就已经确诊了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So Dr. Conley's saying, I didn't really mean that.
sentences.zh: 所以康利医生是在说，我其实不是那个意思。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We still don't know the answer to the question of when the president first tested positive, but Conley said he misspoke.
sentences.zh: 我们至今仍不知道总统首次检测呈阳性的确切时间，但康利说他当时说错了。

sentences.en: And Peter, what else do we see happening on Saturday afternoon?
sentences.zh: 彼得，周六下午我们还看到了什么情况？

sentences.en: Well, then you start to see the president himself kind of get involved.
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后你开始看到总统本人也参与进来了。

sentences.en: I want to begin by thanking all of the incredible medical professionals, the doctors, the nurses, everybody.
sentences.zh: 首先我要感谢所有了不起的医疗专业人员，医生、护士，所有人。

sentences.en: He had taped an 18-second video the day before going to Walter Reed, and he decides to tape another video that can be put online in the evening.
sentences.zh: 他在去沃尔特·里德国家军事医学中心的前一天录制了一段18秒的视频，然后决定在晚上再录一段可以发布到网上的视频。

sentences.en: I came here, wasn't feeling so well.
sentences.zh: 我来到这里时，感觉不太舒服。

sentences.en: I feel much better now.
sentences.zh: 我现在感觉好多了。

sentences.en: We're working hard to get me all the way back.
sentences.zh: 我们正在努力让我完全康复。

sentences.en: I have to be back because we still have to make America great again.
sentences.zh: 我必须康复，因为我们还要让美国再次伟大。

sentences.en: He still looks kind of drained, which would be natural for anybody suffering what he's suffering through.
sentences.zh: 他看起来仍然有些疲惫，这对于任何经历他所经历病情的人来说都是正常的。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: We're going to beat this coronavirus or whatever you want to call it, and we're going to beat it soundly.
sentences.zh: 我们要战胜这种冠状病毒，或者不管你怎么称呼它，我们要彻底战胜它。

sentences.en: So many things have happened.
sentences.zh: 发生了太多的事情。

sentences.en: If you look at the therapeutics.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看这些治疗方法。

sentences.en: It is kind of a rambling talk.
sentences.zh: 这听起来有点语无伦次。

sentences.en: He talks about the campaign, and he talks about how he wants to get back out there and win the campaign.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了竞选活动，谈到了他想如何重返竞选并赢得胜利。

sentences.en: He talks about his handling of the virus, and he insists that he's handled it well.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了自己对病毒的处理，并坚称自己处理得很好。

sentences.en: So I just want to tell you that I'm starting to feel good.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想告诉你们，我开始感觉不错了。

sentences.en: You don't know, over the next period of a few days, I guess that's the real teSt.
sentences.zh: 你不知道，在接下来的几天里，我想那才是真正的考验。

sentences.en: So we'll be seeing what happens over those next couple of days.
sentences.zh: 所以我们将看看接下来几天会发生什么。

sentences.en: But, you know, the larger message is, I'm still here.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，更重要的信息是，我还在这里。

sentences.en: I'm doing well.
sentences.zh: 我做得很好。

sentences.en: It's going to be okay.
sentences.zh: 一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: I'm not going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我哪儿也不会去。

sentences.en: Specifically, the United States, the outpouring of love has been incredible.
sentences.zh: 特别是美国，涌现出的爱意令人难以置信。

sentences.en: I will never forget.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Breaking right now, an update from President Trump's doctors just into Fox News.
sentences.zh: 突发新闻，福克斯新闻刚刚收到特朗普总统医生的最新消息。

sentences.en: And then it's shortly after that that Mark Meadows goes on Janine Pirro.
sentences.zh: 在那之后不久，马克·梅多斯就上了珍妮·皮罗的节目。

sentences.en: Joining me now to discuss this and more, White House Chief of Staff Mark Meadows.
sentences.zh: 现在加入我讨论这个话题及更多内容的是白宫办公厅主任马克·梅多斯。

sentences.en: Mark, I suspect that you've been through a lot in the last couple of days.
sentences.zh: 马克，我猜你过去几天经历了很多。

sentences.en: What is the statement from the doctors?
sentences.zh: 医生们的声明是什么？

sentences.en: Not as much as the President of the United States.
sentences.zh: 没有美国总统经历的多。

sentences.en: And he gives two separate versions of reality.
sentences.zh: 他给出了两个截然不同的现实版本。

sentences.en: Yesterday morning, we were real concerned with that.
sentences.zh: 昨天早上，我们确实对此非常担心。

sentences.en: You know, he had a fever and his blood oxygen level hit rapidly.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他发烧了，血氧水平迅速下降。

sentences.en: And he gave an accurate version of what had happened on Friday with the president.
sentences.zh: 他给出了周五总统身上所发生之事的准确版本。

sentences.en: He talked about his oxygen levels dropping.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了他的血氧水平下降。

sentences.en: That was the first time any official had said that on the record.
sentences.zh: 这是第一次有官员在公开记录中这样说。

sentences.en: But he's made unbelievable improvements from yesterday morning when I know a number of us, the doctor and I, were very concerned.
sentences.zh: 但他从昨天早上开始有了令人难以置信的改善，当时我知道我们中的许多人，包括医生和我，都非常担心。

sentences.en: But then also talked about how well the president is doing and how speculation about transfer of power by the media is very unfair.
sentences.zh: 但随后他也谈到了总统的情况有多好，以及媒体关于权力移交的猜测是非常不公平的。

sentences.en: And while that may make for good clicks on the Internet or make for great hyperbole on TV, you know, there was never a consideration and never even a risk of a transition.
sentences.zh: 虽然这可能在互联网上能博取点击量，或者在电视上能制造夸张的言论，但你知道，从来没有考虑过，甚至从来没有过权力过渡的风险。

sentences.en: And allies of the president and at the White House have gotten very upset with some of the news coverage related to whether the president can retain his powers.
sentences.zh: 总统的盟友和白宫内部对一些关于总统是否能保留权力的报道感到非常不满。

sentences.en: So Meadows was playing to that while also acknowledging that their portrait on Friday was not true.
sentences.zh: 所以梅多斯在迎合这一点，同时也承认他们周五对总统健康状况的描述是不真实的。

sentences.en: Mark Meadows, get a good night's sleep tonight.
sentences.zh: 马克·梅多斯，今晚好好睡一觉。

sentences.en: Thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: So by Saturday evening, we don't really know exactly who is telling the truth or what the exact state of the president's health is.
sentences.zh: 所以到了周六晚上，我们真的不知道到底是谁在说真话，或者总统的健康状况到底如何。

sentences.en: But we do know the president wants to present an optimistic picture of his health.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实知道总统想展示他健康状况乐观的一面。

sentences.en: And that his chief of staff, having learned the president wasn't pleased with his portrait of the president's health,
sentences.zh: 而他的办公厅主任在得知总统对之前描述的健康状况不满意后，

sentences.en: starts to present a more optimistic picture himself on Fox News.
sentences.zh: 开始自己在福克斯新闻上展示出一幅更乐观的画面。

sentences.en: That's about where things stand on Saturday evening.
sentences.zh: 这就是周六晚上的情况。

sentences.en: And we're told, again, you know, we have to trust other people.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知，再次强调，你知道，我们必须信任其他人。

sentences.en: We're told that he was actually feeling better on Saturday evening than he had been on Friday.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知他周六晚上的感觉实际上比周五要好。

sentences.en: And as he headed into a second night in the hospital, was just as concerned in some ways with the external perception than he was his own condition at that moment.
sentences.zh: 当他进入住院的第二个晚上时，他在某些方面对外界的看法和他当时自己的身体状况一样关心。

sentences.en: And what's your understanding of what that is about?
sentences.zh: 你对这到底是怎么回事有什么理解？

sentences.en: I mean, why would President Trump, why would any president really try to mislead the public about their health?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，为什么特朗普总统，为什么任何总统真的会试图在健康问题上误导公众？

sentences.en: Does it have to do with politics or with the significance of the president being unwell when it comes to our sense of national stability or what?
sentences.zh: 这与政治有关，还是与总统身体不适对我们国家稳定感的影响有关，或者是什么？

sentences.en: I think it's all of those things.
sentences.zh: 我认为这些因素都有。

sentences.en: I really do think, you know, there's a natural condition inside the Oval Office to want to maintain credibility in the political system.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为，你知道，椭圆形办公室内部有一种想要维护政治体制信誉的自然倾向。

sentences.en: And that includes the international political system.
sentences.zh: 这包括国际政治体系。

sentences.en: And any weakness is obviously a drawback.
sentences.zh: 任何软弱显然都是一种劣势。

sentences.en: So there is a natural tendency, even if it's unfortunate, to shade the truth in these kinds of circumstances.
sentences.zh: 所以，即使令人遗憾，在这种情况下，也有一种掩盖真相的自然倾向。

sentences.en: Now, of course, the difference is this is a White House that has had a credibility problem on all sorts of things from day one,
sentences.zh: 当然，不同之处在于，这是一个从第一天起就在各种事情上存在信誉问题的白宫，

sentences.en: leaving a lot of people wondering what they can trust and what they can't.
sentences.zh: 让很多人怀疑他们能相信什么，不能相信什么。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the other piece of that that I would just add to what Peter said,
sentences.zh: 关于这一点，我想在彼得所说的基础上再补充一点，

sentences.en: this is a president who sees any sign of illness as a huge signal of weakness and who sees hospitals as dangerous, germy places.
sentences.zh: 这是一位将任何疾病迹象都视为软弱的巨大信号，并将医院视为危险、充满细菌的地方的总统。

sentences.en: And so all of this is sort of Donald Trump's worst personal nightmare for a variety of reasons.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切对于唐纳德·特朗普来说，出于各种原因，都是他个人最糟糕的噩梦。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且不需要输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Okay, so Maggie, what happens on Sunday?
sentences.zh: 好的，玛吉，周日发生了什么？

sentences.en: So, Michael, Sunday, around the same time, 1130 in the morning, Dr. Conley comes back to a lectern with a microphone with a team of doctors.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，周日大约在同一时间，上午11点30分，康利医生带着一个医疗团队回到了讲台和麦克风前。

sentences.en: This time they're all wearing masks.
sentences.zh: 这次他们都戴着口罩。

sentences.en: Morning, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。

sentences.en: Since we spoke last, the president has continued to improve.
sentences.zh: 自我们上次交谈以来，总统的情况持续好转。

sentences.en: And Dr. Conley offers more candid information than he did the day before.
sentences.zh: 康利医生提供了比前一天更坦诚的信息。

sentences.en: The president had a high fever, and his oxygen saturation was transiently dipping below 94%.
sentences.zh: 总统曾高烧，血氧饱和度短暂降至94%以下。

sentences.en: Given these two developments, I was concerned for possible rapid progression of the illness.
sentences.zh: 鉴于这两个进展，我担心病情可能会迅速恶化。

sentences.en: I recommended the president we try some supplemental oxygen, see how he'd respond.
sentences.zh: 我建议总统尝试使用一些补充氧气，看看他的反应如何。

sentences.en: He says that the president's oxygen levels did indeed drop on Friday, and that he'd had a quote-unquote high fever.
sentences.zh: 他说总统的血氧水平在周五确实下降了，而且他曾有过所谓的“高烧”。

sentences.en: And this all precipitated him being taken to Walter Reed Hospital later that day.
sentences.zh: 这一切促使他在当天晚些时候被送往沃尔特·里德医院。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So a different account than going to Walter Reed out of an abundance of caution.
sentences.zh: 所以这与“出于谨慎考虑”去沃尔特·里德医院的说法不同。

sentences.en: This is perhaps going to Walter Reed out of a kind of medical reaction to something happening to the president.
sentences.zh: 这或许是出于对总统身上发生的事情的一种医疗反应而前往沃尔特·里德医院。

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And, Michael, look, it is important to bear in mind that he is still the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，听着，记住他仍然是美国总统这一点很重要。

sentences.en: He's not a normal, typical patient.
sentences.zh: 他不是一个普通的典型病人。

sentences.en: So they're going to take more preventative measures with him than they would with someone else.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会对他采取比其他人更多的预防措施。

sentences.en: But this is the first thing that Conley establishes, is that the president was sicker than they were saying on Friday.
sentences.zh: 但这是康利确立的第一件事，即总统周五的情况比他们所说的要严重。

sentences.en: And now we knew that for sure.
sentences.zh: 现在我们确定了这一点。

sentences.en: Over the course of his illness, the president has experienced two episodes of transient drops in his oxygen saturation.
sentences.zh: 在患病过程中，总统经历了两次血氧饱和度短暂下降的情况。

sentences.en: He makes clear then that the president had a second incident on Saturday where his oxygen level dropped.
sentences.zh: 他随后明确表示，总统周六发生了第二次血氧水平下降的事件。

sentences.en: He was vague on whether they administered supplemental oxygen to him.
sentences.zh: 他对于是否给总统使用了补充氧气含糊其辞。

sentences.en: It was a determination of the team, based predominantly on the timeline from the initial diagnosis, that we initiate dexamethasone.
sentences.zh: 医疗团队主要根据最初确诊的时间表，决定启动地塞米松治疗。

sentences.en: He let us know that the president is on a steroid, which is being administered to, quote unquote, severe cases of COVID patients.
sentences.zh: 他让我们知道总统正在使用一种类固醇，这种药物被用于所谓的“重症”新冠患者。

sentences.en: He did not describe the president's condition that way, but he is taking this steroid, which is an anti-inflammatory and an immune suppressant.
sentences.zh: 他没有那样描述总统的病情，但他确实在服用这种类固醇，这是一种抗炎药和免疫抑制剂。

sentences.en: Are there signs of pneumonia?
sentences.zh: 有肺炎的迹象吗？

sentences.en: Are there signs of lung involvement or any damage to the lungs?
sentences.zh: 有肺部受累或肺部损伤的迹象吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so we're tracking all of that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们正在追踪所有这些情况。

sentences.en: There's some expected findings, but nothing of any major clinical concern.
sentences.zh: 有一些预期的发现，但没有什么重大的临床担忧。

sentences.en: And he made clear that they are monitoring the president's lung function,
sentences.zh: 他明确表示他们正在监测总统的肺功能，

sentences.en: where he said there are expected findings in the scans and then didn't explain what the expected findings are or what that means.
sentences.zh: 他说扫描中有预期的发现，但没有解释什么是预期的发现，或者这意味着什么。

sentences.en: And if he continues to look and feel as well as he does today, our hope is that we can plan for a discharge as early as tomorrow to the White House,
sentences.zh: 如果他今天继续保持良好的状态和感觉，我们的希望是我们可以计划最早在明天让他出院回到白宫，

sentences.en: where he can continue his treatment course.
sentences.zh: 在那里他可以继续他的治疗疗程。

sentences.en: He also said they might release the president as soon as Monday.
sentences.zh: 他还说他们可能最早在周一让总统出院。

sentences.en: He did not explain how those various facts fit together.
sentences.zh: 他没有解释这些不同的事实是如何联系在一起的。

sentences.en: He said the president is doing better.
sentences.zh: 他说总统的情况正在好转。

sentences.en: Yesterday, you told us that the president was in great shape, had been in good shape and fever-free for the previous 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 昨天，你告诉我们总统身体状况极佳，一直处于良好状态，并且在过去24小时内没有发烧。

sentences.en: Minutes after your press conference, White House Chief of Staff Mark Meadows told reporters that the president's vitals were very concerning over the past 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 在你的新闻发布会几分钟后，白宫办公厅主任马克·梅多斯告诉记者，总统在过去24小时内的生命体征非常令人担忧。

sentences.en: Simple question for the American people.
sentences.zh: 给美国人民一个简单的问题。

sentences.en: Whose statements about the president's health should we believe?
sentences.zh: 我们应该相信谁关于总统健康状况的声明？

sentences.en: And then he was pressed on why he gave a very different portrait a day earlier.
sentences.zh: 然后他被追问为什么前一天给出了截然不同的描述。

sentences.en: There was that momentary episode of the high fever and that temporary drop in the saturation.
sentences.zh: 当时确实出现了高烧和血氧饱和度暂时下降的瞬间情况。

sentences.en: And he acknowledged that he had done that.
sentences.zh: 他承认他那样做了。

sentences.en: I was trying to reflect the upbeat attitude that the team, the president, that his course of illness has had.
sentences.zh: 我当时试图反映团队和总统所持有的乐观态度，以及他患病的进程。

sentences.en: And he said that his goal was to try to be upbeat.
sentences.zh: 他说他的目标是尽量保持乐观。

sentences.en: I didn't want to give any information that might steer the course of illness in another direction.
sentences.zh: 我不想提供任何可能引导病情向另一个方向发展的消息。

sentences.en: And in doing so, you know, it came off that we were trying to hide something, which wasn't necessarily true.
sentences.zh: 这样做的话，你知道，看起来好像我们在试图隐瞒什么，这不一定是真的。

sentences.en: And so here I have it.
sentences.zh: 所以我就是这样做的。

sentences.en: And to not steer the course of the virus in the wrong direction.
sentences.zh: 并且不让病毒的进程向错误的方向发展。

sentences.en: What did you make of that?
sentences.zh: 你对此有何看法？

sentences.en: I must confess, I did not understand that set of words.
sentences.zh: 我必须承认，我不理解那番话。

sentences.en: What he meant was that he wanted Donald Trump to hear upbeat good news.
sentences.zh: 他的意思是，他想让唐纳德·特朗普听到乐观的好消息。

sentences.en: And the White House communications director has since confirmed that that's what Dr. Conley meant.
sentences.zh: 白宫通讯联络主任此后证实了康利医生的意思确实如此。

sentences.en: So the doctor is saying that he did not want to tell the public too much about the president's condition, that his oxygen had fallen, that he needed supplemental oxygen,
sentences.zh: 所以医生是在说，他不想向公众透露太多关于总统病情的信息，比如他的血氧下降了，他需要补充氧气，

sentences.en: that his fever had spiked, because he feared that actually might make the president, as a recipient of that information, get sicker?
sentences.zh: 他的高烧加剧了，因为他担心作为信息接收者的总统，如果听到这些，病情反而会加重？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Remember, this is the president who has long subscribed to the Norman Vincent Peale School of Positive Thinking, that, you know, that simply being upbeat, being optimistic,
sentences.zh: 记住，这位总统长期以来一直信奉诺曼·文森特·皮尔的“积极思维”学派，即，你知道，仅仅保持乐观、保持积极，

sentences.en: actually has an impact.
sentences.zh: 实际上是有影响的。

sentences.en: And he has used that to explain over and over again why he has underestimated or undersold, at least, the severity of this pandemic from the start.
sentences.zh: 他曾多次用这一点来解释为什么他从一开始就低估或至少淡化了这场大流行的严重性。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So one way, perhaps,
sentences.zh: 所以也许有一种方式，

sentences.en: of understanding all this back and forth and conflicting information over the weekend is that the president genuinely believes that his health can be affected by a kind of positive framing of his health.
sentences.zh: 来理解周末所有这些反复和相互矛盾的信息，那就是总统真诚地相信他的健康状况会受到一种对他健康状况的积极描述的影响。

sentences.en: Or that his health could be adversely affected by an accurate public framing of his health.
sentences.zh: 或者说他的健康状况可能会因为对他健康状况的准确公开描述而受到不利影响。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So I want to talk for a moment about the other administration officials and people in the White House around the president who have tested positive for the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 我想花点时间谈谈白宫里其他几位新冠病毒检测呈阳性的行政官员和总统身边的人。

sentences.en: When we talked to you both on Friday afternoon, it was the president, the first lady, Melania Trump, Hope Hicks, his senior advisor, the chairman of the RNC, Ronna McDaniel.
sentences.zh: 我们周五下午采访你们二位时，提到的人包括总统、第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普、高级顾问霍普·希克斯，以及共和党全国委员会主席罗娜·麦克丹尼尔。

sentences.en: It was Senator Mike Lee of Utah, the president of Notre Dame.
sentences.zh: 还有犹他州的迈克·李参议员，以及圣母大学的校长。

sentences.en: Who else has since tested positive?
sentences.zh: 此后还有谁检测呈阳性？

sentences.en: Well, since then, we've had, I think, Chris Christie, the former governor of New Jersey, who was the president's debate coach this past week.
sentences.zh: 嗯，此后还有新泽西州前州长克里斯·克里斯蒂，他过去一周一直担任总统的辩论教练。

sentences.en: We've had Nick Luna, who is his former body man, his personal aide, who's now the director of Oval Office Operations.
sentences.zh: 还有尼克·卢纳，他是总统的前贴身随从、私人助理，现在担任椭圆形办公室运营主任。

sentences.en: We've had Senator Tom Tillis, I think, was probably after we talked on Friday.
sentences.zh: 还有汤姆·蒂利斯参议员，我想那应该是在我们周五交谈之后的事了。

sentences.en: We've had a number of reporters, including our own colleague, Mike Scheer,
sentences.zh: 还有几位记者，包括我们的同事迈克·希尔，

sentences.en: who was on the plane with the president following the Amy Coney Barrett event to hit the rally that followed that.
sentences.zh: 他当时和总统一起乘飞机参加了艾米·科尼·巴雷特的活动，随后又去参加了紧接着举行的集会。

sentences.en: Kellyanne Conway?
sentences.zh: 凯莉安·康威呢？

sentences.en: We had Kellyanne Conway, that's right, who was no longer in the White House, but was part of that Barrett event as well.
sentences.zh: 没错，还有凯莉安·康威，她虽然已经不在白宫工作了，但也参加了那场巴雷特活动。

sentences.en: And what more do we now understand about how the transmission might have occurred?
sentences.zh: 关于病毒传播可能发生的方式，我们现在还有什么新的了解？

sentences.en: When we last talked, there was a lot of attention being paid to this Rose Garden event last weekend, the nomination of Amy Coney Barrett to the Supreme Court,
sentences.zh: 我们上次交谈时，人们非常关注上周末在玫瑰园举行的活动，即提名艾米·科尼·巴雷特进入最高法院的那场活动，

sentences.en: because so many of these figures had been present for that.
sentences.zh: 因为当时有这么多重要人物在场。

sentences.en: So what more have we learned?
sentences.zh: 那么我们又了解到了什么新情况？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think everybody is really now focused on that event.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想大家现在确实都聚焦在那场活动上。

sentences.en: The White House Medical Unit is certainly examining that carefully.
sentences.zh: 白宫医疗小组当然正在仔细审查此事。

sentences.en: So many people who were there have come out of it with positive tests that, in fact, I think the mayor of D.C.
sentences.zh: 出席那场活动的人中，有太多人后来检测呈阳性，事实上，我想华盛顿特区市长

sentences.en: said that would be the largest single super spreader event that has happened in the course of the pandemic in the city to this point.
sentences.zh: 曾表示，那将是该市疫情爆发以来发生的最大规模的单一超级传播事件。

sentences.en: So that's an obvious source of the outbreak.
sentences.zh: 所以那是疫情爆发的一个显而易见的源头。

sentences.en: And we had originally thought, well, it seems sort of counterintuitive because while people weren't wearing masks and were not socially distant, they were outside,
sentences.zh: 我们最初认为，这似乎有点违背常理，因为虽然人们没有戴口罩，也没有保持社交距离，但他们是在户外，

sentences.en: which is thought to be a safer way.
sentences.zh: 而户外被认为是一种更安全的方式。

sentences.en: What we didn't really focus on at first, I think, was the fact that a lot of those people came inside the White House afterwards.
sentences.zh: 我想我们最初没有真正关注到的是，这些人中有许多人在活动结束后进入了白宫内部。

sentences.en: There was kind of a reception in the diplomatic reception room, and the pictures that have emerged have indicated just how close everyone was.
sentences.zh: 在外交接待室举行了一场招待会，流出的照片显示当时每个人靠得有多近。

sentences.en: There was even some hugging and certainly very close talking, no masks, no social distance,
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一些拥抱，当然还有非常近距离的交谈，没有口罩，没有社交距离，

sentences.en: exactly the kind of circumstances that a public health expert would tell you not to do right now.
sentences.zh: 这正是公共卫生专家会告诫你现在绝对不要做的情形。

sentences.en: So also, in addition to these events related to Amy Coney Barrett's selection,
sentences.zh: 所以，除了这些与艾米·科尼·巴雷特提名相关的活动外，

sentences.en: there were rooms that the president was in with about a half dozen aides over several hours over the course of many days from Saturday through Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 从周六到周二的几天里，总统曾与大约六名助手在房间里待了几个小时，

sentences.en: where he was doing debate prep.
sentences.zh: 当时他正在进行辩论准备。

sentences.en: And all of those people then went out and were still doing things after those sessions.
sentences.zh: 而所有这些人后来都出去了，并且在那些会议之后仍在进行各种活动。

sentences.en: Final question for you both.
sentences.zh: 最后问二位一个问题。

sentences.en: We don't know yet how these past few days may end up influencing voters and the outcome of the election.
sentences.zh: 我们还不知道这几天的情况最终会如何影响选民和选举结果。

sentences.en: However, we have just gotten new polling that shows the state of the race just before all of this.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们刚刚获得了新的民调数据，显示了这一切发生前夕的选情状态。

sentences.en: And that polling showed that Joe Biden has never appeared to be doing better nationally.
sentences.zh: 民调显示，乔·拜登在全国范围内的支持率似乎从未如此之高。

sentences.en: And the president is seen in these polls to have done poorly in the first debate.
sentences.zh: 而总统在这些民调中被认为在首场辩论中表现不佳。

sentences.en: So, Maggie and Peter, how is the White House and how is the campaign thinking about what to do in these final weeks,
sentences.zh: 那么，玛吉和彼得，白宫和竞选团队在最后这几周打算怎么做，

sentences.en: given what has just happened to the president and given that polling?
sentences.zh: 考虑到总统刚刚发生的状况以及那些民调结果？

sentences.en: Michael, they're plowing ahead as if nothing has changed.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，他们正在按部就班地推进，仿佛什么都没有改变。

sentences.en: You know, as it is, the doctors are talking about releasing the president as soon as Monday,
sentences.zh: 你知道，医生们正在讨论最早在周一让总统出院，

sentences.en: which is really being driven by political considerations and less about where the president is physically.
sentences.zh: 这更多是出于政治考量，而不是基于总统的身体状况。

sentences.en: And also, frankly, the fact that the president hates being in a hospital and is bored.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，还有一个事实是，总统讨厌待在医院里，觉得很无聊。

sentences.en: But they are sending out Mike Pence, the vice president, to do campaign events as soon as Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 但他们正在安排副总统迈克·彭斯最早在周三参加竞选活动。

sentences.en: They are hoping to have Trump family members campaign across the country.
sentences.zh: 他们希望特朗普家族成员能在全国各地进行竞选活动。

sentences.en: And they're still talking about the second debate as if it's a likely possibility.
sentences.zh: 而且他们还在谈论第二场辩论，仿佛那很有可能举行。

sentences.en: That is scheduled for October 15th.
sentences.zh: 那场辩论定于10月15日举行。

sentences.en: That's pretty soon.
sentences.zh: 那很快就要到了。

sentences.en: And they think that they have an opportunity and they're not wrong to some extent to have the public see him as a sympathetic figure because he's sick.
sentences.zh: 他们认为自己有一个机会——在某种程度上他们没想错——让公众因为他生病而把他视为一个值得同情的形象。

sentences.en: There is a history of politicians being viewed sympathetically when they are sick.
sentences.zh: 政客在生病时被公众同情是有先例的。

sentences.en: The problem is this White House is viewed with so little credibility on a number of issues, but particularly on its handling of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，本届白宫在许多问题上，尤其是对新冠病毒的处理上，信誉度极低。

sentences.en: That that was always going to cut against them.
sentences.zh: 所以这一点总是会让他们处于不利地位。

sentences.en: Couple that with the incompetence and false portraits that have been depicted by this White House in the last few days.
sentences.zh: 再加上白宫过去几天表现出的无能和虚假的形象描绘，

sentences.en: That doesn't help them either.
sentences.zh: 这对他们也没有任何帮助。

sentences.en: But what they're hoping is the president will recover quickly and he'll be able to show resolve in the face of the virus.
sentences.zh: 但他们希望总统能迅速康复，并能展现出面对病毒时的决心。

sentences.en: Maggie, Peter, thank you both very much.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，彼得，非常感谢你们二位。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Sunday evening, President Trump briefly left Walter Reed in his motorcade,
sentences.zh: 周日晚上，特朗普总统短暂离开了沃尔特·里德国家军事医学中心，乘坐车队出行，

sentences.en: loading into an SUV with two Secret Service agents to drive by supporters gathered outside the medical complex.
sentences.zh: 他坐进一辆SUV，由两名特勤局特工陪同，驱车经过聚集在医疗中心外的支持者。

sentences.en: The trip was immediately criticized by medical experts who said it had endangered the agents in the vehicle and had violated medical protocols.
sentences.zh: 此举立即遭到医学专家的批评，他们称这危及了车内的特工，并违反了医疗规程。

sentences.en: We're getting great reports from the doctors.
sentences.zh: 我们从医生那里得到了很好的报告。

sentences.en: This is an incredible hospital.
sentences.zh: 这是一家不可思议的医院。

sentences.en: Walter Reed.
sentences.zh: 沃尔特·里德。

sentences.en: Moments earlier, the president released another video update on Twitter about his experience.
sentences.zh: 就在几分钟前，总统在推特上发布了另一段关于他经历的视频更新。

sentences.en: So it's been a very interesting journey.
sentences.zh: 这是一段非常有趣的旅程。

sentences.en: I learned a lot about COVID.
sentences.zh: 我学到了很多关于新冠病毒的知识。

sentences.en: I learned it by really going to school.
sentences.zh: 我是通过真正地去上学学到的。

sentences.en: This is the real school.
sentences.zh: 这是真正的学校。

sentences.en: This isn't the let's read the book school.
sentences.zh: 这不是那种读读书的学校。

sentences.en: And I get it and I understand it.
sentences.zh: 我明白了，我理解了。

sentences.en: And it's a very interesting thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件非常有趣的事情。

sentences.en: I'm going to be letting you know about it.
sentences.zh: 我会让你们了解相关情况的。

sentences.en: In the meantime, we love the USA and we love what's happening.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，我们热爱美国，我们热爱正在发生的一切。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to end the day.
sentences.zh: 以下是你结束这一天所需了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Right now, we can't live like we're back to the way things used to be.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们不能像以前那样生活了。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the state of Wisconsin is experiencing a widespread and uncontrolled outbreak of the coronavirus, prompting stern warnings from its governor, Tony Evers.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，威斯康星州正在经历一场广泛且失控的新冠疫情，促使其州长托尼·埃弗斯发出了严厉警告。

sentences.en: We can't afford to act like things are business as usual.
sentences.zh: 我们负担不起像往常一样行事。

sentences.en: We have to get back to the basics in fighting this virus.
sentences.zh: 我们必须回归抗击病毒的基本原则。

sentences.en: The state has set a single day record for deaths and hospitalizations and has reached an alarming positive test rate of 20 percent.
sentences.zh: 该州单日死亡和住院人数创下纪录，阳性检测率达到了惊人的20%。

sentences.en: First and foremost, I'm asking you to stay at home.
sentences.zh: 首先，我请求你们待在家里。

sentences.en: Cancel the play dates and the dinner parties.
sentences.zh: 取消玩伴聚会和晚宴。

sentences.en: Tell your friends and family members you'd rather hang out virtually because you care about them and you want to keep them safe.
sentences.zh: 告诉你的朋友和家人，你更愿意在线上聚会，因为你在乎他们，想保护他们的安全。

sentences.en: And I'm going to be giving an update that gives me no joy at all.
sentences.zh: 我即将发布一个让我一点也高兴不起来的更新。

sentences.en: In fact, it pains me to be putting forward this approach that we'll need.
sentences.zh: 事实上，提出这种我们所需要的方案让我感到痛苦。

sentences.en: But in some parts of our city, in Brooklyn and Queens, we're having an extraordinary problem.
sentences.zh: 但在我们城市的一些地方，比如布鲁克林和皇后区，我们正面临一个极其严重的问题。

sentences.en: Fearing a second wave of infections in New York City,
sentences.zh: 由于担心纽约市出现第二波感染，

sentences.en: Mayor Bill de Blasio is imposing severe new restrictions on nine neighborhoods in Brooklyn and Queens where positive test rates are surging.
sentences.zh: 市长比尔·德布拉西奥正在对布鲁克林和皇后区的九个社区实施严厉的新限制措施，这些地区的阳性检测率正在飙升。

sentences.en: So the plan is to rewind in these nine zip codes, to rewind, to go back, to address the problem by using the tools that we know work,
sentences.zh: 所以计划是在这九个邮编区域内倒带，倒带，回到过去，通过使用我们已知有效的方法来解决问题，

sentences.en: which is to ensure that non-essential businesses are not open and a variety of activities are not happening.
sentences.zh: 即确保非必要企业关闭，并停止各种活动。

sentences.en: Inside those communities, the city is closing all schools and non-essential businesses and forbidding both indoor and outdoor dining at restaurants.
sentences.zh: 在这些社区内，市政府正在关闭所有学校和非必要企业，并禁止餐馆提供室内和室外用餐服务。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。
